description: The chart is a donut chart comparing the win rates of different models, with the outer ring representing one set of data and the inner ring representing another. The chart is divided into three slices, with the largest slice labeled "GPT-4o" and colored blue, making up approximately 96.8% of the outer ring, and the corresponding inner ring slice also labeled "GPT-4o" but colored red, making up around 98.4%. The smallest slice is labeled "LLaMA" and colored light blue, making up about 3.2% of the outer ring, while the inner ring does not have a corresponding visible slice for LLaMA. The chart includes labels with percentage values for each slice, and the slices are visually distinct due to their colors and labels. The inner ring has a label "Win rate (%)" in the center.
